paragraphs.text: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that registers a greet tool callable by the model.
A DeepSeek Harness plugin that registers a `greet` tool callable by the model.

- Plugin ID: `greet`
- Tool: `greet(name: string)` → `Hello, {name}!`
- Host only — no UI yet.
Install into a profile (bundle form, local checkout):
> For git installs the package ships plain ESM (`index.js`), so no build step is required. If you pu
blish to npm, use `dsh plugin --profile demo add dsh-greet-plugin`.
Then start and ask the model:
